items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: The Excelsior band. Excelsior band I was in. Well, Peter Boccage was in that band.

ctx.x: 10, 11 years. I wonder why they called it Pacific. This is Pacific Street, isn't it? Yeah, yeah. Well, that's the old Pacific band. During that time they had the Pacific, there wasn't no such thing as a Tuxedo band. It wasn't existing. Is there any Pacific railroad or anything here that they might? Well, they had the Southern Pacific right back here, you know. Pacific right back here.

Yeah, Southern Pacific. Used to be the shop right there. Maybe that's it. Maybe that's what they called it, yeah. They had that band. They had the Golden Leaf band. They had about two or three of them around here. Well, the Tuxedo band wasn't in existing during that time. Oh, before that time. Yeah, that was in Miami. The Excelsior band. Excelsior band I was in. Well, Peter Boccage was in that band.
Was their headquarters mostly over here on this side or the other side of the river?
